quotes.text: // `ConflictResolution`. Instead, we will use `AlwaysOverwrite` for now.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The missing ChangeKey explains why this read-status request does not use AutoResolve. It does not prove AlwaysOverwrite is the only remaining policy: the reviewer named NeverOverwrite as another possible value and requested softer wording. The final patch says it uses AlwaysOverwrite for now. Preserve the actual constraint and identify the overwrite choice as a scoped implementation preference. This supplements the existing workaround lesson; it does not recommend overwriting all remote conflicts.
title: Do not describe an EWS conflict-policy preference as the only possible value
